caption: The drawing depicts a textile featuring a repeating pattern with intricate objects and designs. The textile is primarily composed of alternating sections of red and blue, with white or cream-colored motifs woven throughout. The top portion features a series of leafy branches, flowers, and a pineapple in a central urn. Below this, there are pairs of birds, including two birds facing each other in a central red panel and two birds perched on either side in blue panels, along with an urn containing floral arrangements. The lower portion of the textile showcases rows of buildings with distinctive windows, doors, and cupolas, interspersed with leafy trees, some resembling palm trees. The right side of the textile contains vertical bands with smaller repeating scenes of houses and trees. The edges of the textile have frayed fringes, with the color of the fringe varying between blue and red in different areas.
title: Woven Jacquard Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
